blocks.text: Police are examining the medical condition of the driver whose car plunged from a hotel building’s parking area in Makati City on Thursday, as investigators seek to establish whether negligence or criminal liability played a role in the incident. In an interview on Friday, Lt. Margaret Panaga, public information officer of the Southern Police District, said the 55-year-old driver was a reliever employed by an unnamed agency and had been assigned to pick up a passenger on Thursday. The driver died after his car fell from the fourth floor parking area of Citadines Benavidez Makati, an establishment offering serviced apartments and […]...
